item.title: Democratic Party Proposes Special Counsel Bill for Election Commission… "Opposition's Recommendation of Special Counsel is Absurd" (민주당, 선관위 특검법 발의…“야당 특검 추천은 어불성설”)
item.description:
Democratic Party Proposes Special Counsel Bill for Election Commission… "Opposition's Recommendation of Special Counsel is Absurd" (민주당, 선관위 특검법 발의…“야당 특검 추천은 어불성설”)

The Democratic Party of Korea announced on the 9th that it will propose a special counsel bill regarding the shortage of ballots during the June 3 local elections. (더불어민주당은 9일 6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태와 관련한 특검법을 발의한다고 밝혔다.)

On that day, Cheon Jun-ho, the Democratic Party's principal deputy floor leader for operations, stated, "We must clearly investigate the violation of voting rights by the Election Commission, which grew negligent without oversight," revealing plans for the special counsel bill. (이날 천준호 민주당 원내운영수석은 “감시받지 않고 태만해진 선관위의 참정권 침해를 명명백백히 수사해야 한다”며 특검법 발의 계획을 밝혔다.)

Differences emerged with the opposition over the method of recommending the special counsel. Cheon said, "I can agree with the argument that party recommendations should be excluded from this special counsel bill," while adding, "The bill being proposed today explicitly designates three third-party organizations as the recommending entities." (특검의 추천 방식에 대해서는 야당과 이견을 보였다. 천 수석은 “이번 특검법에서 정당 추천을 배제해야 한다는 주장에 동의할 수 있다”면서도 “오늘 발의하는 특검법에서 추천권자를 3개의 제3자 단체로 명시했다”고 했다.)

Cheon also remarked, "But the People Power Party insists that only they should recommend the special counsel." He questioned, "Isn't this an attempt to induce results that align with the baseless election fraud theory under the orders of Representative Jang Dong-hyuk?" (천 수석은 “그런데 국민의힘은 특검을 오직 자신들만 추천해야 한다고 고집하고 있다”고 했다. “장동혁 대표의 지령을 받아 부정선거론에 부합하는 결과를 유도하려는 것 아닌가”라고도 반문했다.)

He further stated, "The National Assembly should quickly process the special counsel bill with a third-party recommendation for the Election Commission and resolve the situation of voting rights infringement." (또 “국회는 제3자 추천 선관위 특검법을 속히 처리하고 참정권 침해 사태를 해소해야 한다”고도 했다.)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk cancels meeting with Prime Minister Han... heads to Gwangju for meeting over 'Jang Yun-gi case' (장동혁, 韓총리 회동 취소... ‘장윤기 사건’ 면담차 광주행)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk cancels meeting with Prime Minister Han... heads to Gwangju for meeting over 'Jang Yun-gi case' (장동혁, 韓총리 회동 취소... ‘장윤기 사건’ 면담차 광주행)

People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk canceled his scheduled meeting with new Prime Minister Han Sung-sook on the 9th and instead met with the Gwangju Police Chief in connection with the so-called 'Jang Yun-gi case,' where a high school girl was murdered in Gwangju. <<> On the same day, the People Power Party announced that leader Jang would visit the Gwangju Police Agency regarding the Jang Yun-gi case. The police, who initially investigated the murder of a Gwangju high school girl that occurred on May 5, applied a simple murder charge against Jang Yun-gi and sent the case to the prosecution nine days later. However, the prosecution, upon receiving the case, conducted supplementary investigations and uncovered that Jang's father, a police officer, had disposed of some evidence, leading to an indictment for murder during a rape, rather than simple murder. <<> It was reported that leader Jang would meet with the Gwangju Police Chief that day to raise concerns about public safety issues, along with allegations of police cover-ups revealed during the investigation, and opposition to the abolition of the prosecution's supplementary investigation authority. <<> During a Supreme Council meeting held earlier that morning at the National Assembly in Yeouido, Seoul, he stated, "The recent heinous case of Jang Yun-gi raping and murdering a high school girl has once again proven how important the prosecution's supplementary investigation authority is." <<> Leader Jang elaborated, "The father, a current police executive, destroyed evidence of his son's crime. The head of the investigation team provided the father with investigative information and took the lead in downplaying the case." <<> He then targeted President Lee Jae-myung, saying, "When a soldier becomes president, soldiers are respected; when a businessman becomes president, businessmen are respected; but when a criminal becomes president, only criminals are respected." He added, "The dismantling of the prosecution and the revocation of supplementary investigation authority are ultimately about creating a paradise for criminals. I urge you to immediately stop the reckless dismantling of the prosecution." <<> Floor leader Jeong Jeom-sik also stated, "Right now, many citizens are worried about whether the police's complete monopoly over investigation powers, without any checks and balances, can be implemented as they watch the Jang Yun-gi rape and murder case." He added, "The next step will likely be a special prosecution law to cancel President Lee Jae-myung's trial by withdrawing the indictment." (국민의힘 장동혁 대표가 9일 예정됐던 한성숙 신임 국무총리와의 회동을 취소하고 광주에서 여고생이 피살된 이른바 ‘장윤기 사건’과 관련해 광주경찰청장과 면담한다.)

item.title: Lee Je-hoon, Former Hankyoreh Editor-in-Chief, Appointed Head of National Institute for Peaceful Unification and Democratic Education (국립평화통일민주교육원장에 이제훈 전 한겨레 편집국장)
item.description:
Lee Je-hoon, Former Hankyoreh Editor-in-Chief, Appointed Head of National Institute for Peaceful Unification and Democratic Education (국립평화통일민주교육원장에 이제훈 전 한겨레 편집국장)

The Ministry of Unification announced on the 9th that it has appointed Lee Je-hoon, former editor-in-chief of The Hankyoreh, as the head of the National Institute for Peaceful Unification and Democratic Education. (통일부는 9일 국립평화통일민주교육원장에 이제훈 전 한겨레신문 편집국장을 임용했다고 밝혔다.)

The new director, born in 1965, graduated from Seoul National University with a degree in Sociology. He joined The Hankyoreh as part of the 6th open recruitment in 1993 and began covering inter-Korean relations in the early 2000s, when a turning point in the relationship emerged, building his expertise in North Korea and unification issues. (신임 이 원장은 1965년생으로 서울대 사회학과를 졸업했다. 1993년 한겨레 신문 공채6기로 입사해 남북관계가 전환기를 맞이한 2000년 대 초반부터 남북관계를 취재하며 북한·통일 분야 전문성을 쌓았다.)

He earned a doctorate in 2016 from the University of North Korean Studies, with a dissertation on "Roh Tae-woo's Northern Policy and Asymmetric Post-Cold War: Focusing on the Influence of South-North-U.S. Triangular Relations and the Three-Party Merger." From March 2017 to March 2018, he served as editor-in-chief of The Hankyoreh and continued as a senior reporter covering North Korea and unification. He published two books: "Asymmetric Post-Cold War 1990-2020" in 2023 and "Nuclear-Armed Joseon, What Will Korea Choose?" in 2025. (2016년 북한대학원대학교에서 ‘노태우 정부의 북방정책과 비대칭적 탈냉전:남·북·미 3각 관계와 3당 합당의 영향을 중심으로’를 주제로 박사학위를 받았다. 2017년 3월~2018년 3월 한겨레신문 편집국장을 지낸 뒤 선임기자로 북한·통일 분야 취재를 계속했다. 20023년에 ‘비대칭 탈냉전 1990~2020’, 2025년에 ‘핵무장 조선, 한국의 선택은’ 등 두 권의 책을 냈다.)

The National Institute for Peaceful Unification and Democratic Education, an agency under the Ministry of Unification, has played a role in developing unification education content for schools and society, fostering consensus on unification. The director position is an open-type senior executive service (Grade A) role with a two-year term. During the Yoon Suk-yeol administration, Ko Young-hwan, the first defector diplomat from North Korea, was appointed in May 2024, but he resigned in February, leaving three months of his term unfilled, creating a vacancy. The institute began as the Unification Research Institute in 1972, was restructured as the Unification Education Institute in 1996, renamed the National Unification Education Institute in 2021, and was given its current name in November last year after Minister of Unification Chung Dong-young took office. (국립평화통일민주교육원은 통일부 산하 기관으로 학교·사회 통일교육 콘텐츠 개발 등 통일 공감대 확산을 뒷받침하는 역할을 해왔다. 원장은 임기 2년의 개방형 일반직고위공무원(가급) 직위로 윤석열 정부때인 2024년 5월 ‘탈북 외교관 1호’인 고영환 전 원장이 임명됐으나 임기를 석달 남겨둔 지난 2월 사퇴하면서 공석이 됐다. 국립평화통일민주교육원은 1972년 통일연구소로 출발해 1996년 통일교육원으로 개편된 뒤 2021년 ‘국립통일교육원’으로 명칭이 변경됐다. 정동영 통일부 장관 취임 이후인 지난해 11월 현재 명칭으로 기관명이 바뀌었다.)

item.title: Despite concerns over the ‘high school girl murder case’… Ruling party: “Supplementary investigation rights are not necessarily the solution” (‘여고생 피살 사건’ 우려에도...與 “반드시 보완수사권이 해결책은 아니야”)
item.description:
Despite concerns over the ‘high school girl murder case’… Ruling party: “Supplementary investigation rights are not necessarily the solution” (‘여고생 피살 사건’ 우려에도...與 “반드시 보완수사권이 해결책은 아니야”)

Amid growing concerns over the abolition of prosecutors' supplementary investigation rights following the ‘Jeonnam-Gwangju high school girl murder case’, the Democratic Party of Korea on the 9th once again announced its intention to propose an amendment to the Criminal Procedure Act that includes the abolition of these rights. The Democratic Party stated that while it maintains its policy to abolish supplementary investigation rights, it will strengthen the substantive nature of the right to request supplementary investigations and incorporate mechanisms to ensure the fairness of police investigations into the bill. (‘전남광주 여고생 피살 사건’을 계기로 검찰 보완수사권 폐지에 대한 우려가 커지는 가운데, 더불어민주당은 9일 보완수사권 폐지를 담은 형사소송법 개정안 발의를 재차 예고했다. 민주당은 보완수사권 폐지 방침은 유지하되, 보완수사요구권을 실질화하고 경찰 수사의 공정성을 담보할 장치를 법안에 반영하겠다고 밝혔다.)

Kim Han-gyu, the Democratic Party’s senior deputy floor leader for policy, met with reporters after a floor leadership meeting and said, “The Democratic Party’s task force (TF) for revising the Criminal Procedure Act has held several internal discussions, and we plan to finalize the amendment at a meeting at 2 p.m. today.” Representative Kim added, “Several lawmakers are still offering opinions, so it has not been finalized yet. We aim to propose it this afternoon if possible.” (김한규 민주당 원내정책수석부대표는 이날 원내대책회의 뒤 기자들과 만나 “민주당 형사소송법 개정 태스크포스(TF)가 여러 차례 내부 논의를 했고, 마지막으로 오늘 오후 2시 회의를 열어 개정안을 확정할 예정”이라고 했다. 김한규 의원은 “현재도 여러 의원들이 의견을 주고 있어 아직 확정되지는 않았다”며 “되도록 오늘 오후 중으로 발의하려고 한다”고 했다.)

Regarding growing concerns over the abolition of supplementary investigation rights due to the Jang Yun-gi case, Representative Kim stated, “The party’s policy to abolish supplementary investigation rights remains unchanged.” He added, “We are fundamentally considering ways to make the right to request supplementary investigations more substantive, and we are examining how to reflect issues such as complaints from accusers and suspects or human rights protections in the bill.” (김 의원은 장윤기 사건으로 보완수사권 폐지 우려가 커지는 데 대해 “보완수사권을 폐지하는 당의 방침은 바뀌지 않았다”고 했다. 그러면서 “기본적으로 보완수사요구권을 실질화하는 방안, 고발인과 피의자의 이의제기 또는 인권 보호를 위한 문제를 더 많이 검토해 법안에 반영하는 방안을 고민 중”이라고 했다.)

On the Jang Yun-gi case, he said, “It is true that supplementary investigations confirmed the shortcomings of the police investigation,” but added, “Supplementary investigation rights are not necessarily the solution.” He explained, “We identified the deficiencies through requests, and a system is being prepared to enable that. We are developing measures to make it virtually impossible for the police to refuse supplementary investigation requests, more so than in the past.” (그는 장윤기 사건에 대해서도 “보완수사를 통해 경찰 수사의 미진한 부분을 확인한 것은 맞는다”면서도 “반드시 보완수사권이 해결 방안은 아닌 것 같다”고 했다. 그는 “요구를 통해서 미진한 부분을 찾아냈고, 그럴 수 있도록 하는 제도가 준비되고 있다”며 “과거보다 보완수사요구에 경찰이 응할 수밖에 없게 실질화하는 방안을 마련하고 있다”고 했다.)

The Democratic Party is also considering mechanisms to prevent fairness concerns at the stage of assigning police investigation teams. Representative Kim said, “Similar to the court system of exclusion, challenge, and recusal of judges, I think it’s more important not to assign cases to investigation teams with conflicts of interest or where impartial investigations cannot be expected.” He added, “Such incidents may have occurred because the police lack that system. To prevent recurrence, we need to establish a system that prevents investigations from being assigned to teams where fairness is in doubt.” (민주당은 경찰 수사팀 배정 단계에서 공정성 우려를 차단하는 장치도 검토하고 있다. 김 의원은 “재판부의 제척·기피·회피 제도와 마찬가지로 이해관계자나 기타 공정한 수사를 기대할 수 없는 수사팀에게 사건을 맡기지 않는 게 더 중요하지 않나 싶다”고 했다. 이어 “경찰에 그런 시스템이 준비되지 않았기 때문에 이런 사건이 발생하지 않았나 싶다”며 “이런 문제가 재발하지 않도록 수사 공정성이 우려되는 수사팀에 수사가 배정되지 않도록 시스템을 마련하는 게 필요하다”고 했다.)

The amendment is expected to be proposed as the party’s TF bill for revising the Criminal Procedure Act. Senior Deputy Floor Leader Kim said, “You can think of it as the TF bill, and it will be proposed under the names of the floor leadership.” He noted, “Representative Park Sang-hyuk, floor member Kim Han-gyu, Representative Lee Hae-sik of the Public Administration and Security Committee, and Representative Kim Seung-won of the Legislation and Judiciary Committee, among others, are discussing it together. It’s not just individual opinions; we’ve reflected the views of the relevant standing committees, and various lawmakers have provided input and expressed concerns, which we are trying to incorporate as much as possible.” (개정안은 당 형사소송법 개정 TF 안으로 발의될 예정이다. 김 수석은 “TF 안이라고 보면 되고, 발의는 원내대표단 명의로 하게 될 것”이라고 했다. 그는 “박상혁 의원, 원내의 김한규, 행안위의 이해식 의원, 법사위 김승원 간사 등이 같이 논의하고 있다”며 “개인 의견이 아니라 소관 상임위 의견을 반영했고, 여러 의원들이 개별적으로 의견을 주고 우려를 표하기도 해 최대한 반영하려고 하고 있다”고 했다.)

However, Representative Kim said, “It is not yet a party line.” He added, “We will report to the general meeting of lawmakers and decide later whether to pursue it as a party line. There are other bills already proposed, so we will review them together, conduct initial discussions in the Legislation and Judiciary Committee, and then likely explain the bill to lawmakers once opinions are somewhat consolidated.” (다만 김 의원은 “아직 당론은 아니다”라고 했다. 그는 “의원총회에 보고하고 당론 추진 여부는 추후 결정하겠다”며 “기존에 발의된 다른 법안들도 있어 함께 병합 심사하고, 법사위에서 1차 논의한 다음 의견이 어느 정도 모아지면 의원들에게 법안을 설명하지 않을까 싶다”고 했다.)

Regarding the timing of the bill’s passage, he said, “Starting tomorrow, a subcommittee on bills will be held to review the amendment to the Criminal Procedure Act. It doesn’t seem like a situation to specify an exact timeline.” Representative Kim added, “Yesterday, the Legislation and Judiciary Committee said it would hold meetings up to twice a week for swift review, and since the Criminal Procedure Act is one of the important bills, we plan to review it quickly.” (법안 처리 시점에 대해서는 “내일부터 법안소위를 열어 형사소송법 개정안 심사가 예정돼 있다”며 “처리 시점을 딱 특정할 상황은 아닌 것 같다”고 했다. 김 의원은 “어제 법사위에서 필요하면 주 2회 열어 신속 검토하겠다고 했고, 형소법도 중요한 법안 중 하나라 빠르게 심사할 예정”이라고 했다.)

He said, “Depending on the circumstances, it could be processed before the party convention,” but added, “Since the Criminal Procedure Act significantly impacts the judicial system, we expect the People Power Party (PPP) to provide meaningful opinions even if they oppose it.” He continued, “I don’t think we will seek unilateral passage. If the PPP joins in early, we can have in-depth discussions and address various issues with the Criminal Procedure Act.” However, he noted, “We will begin reviewing the bill even before the PPP joins.” (그는 “경우에 따라 전당대회 전까지 처리될 수 있다”면서도 “형사소송법이 사법체계에 중요한 영향을 미치기 때문에 국민의힘이 반대하더라도 의미 있는 의견을 주길 기대한다”고 했다. 이어 “단독 처리를 원하지 않을 것이라고 생각한다”며 “국민의힘이 빨리 들어와야 심도 있게 논의하고 형사소송법의 여러 문제에 대해 논의할 수 있다”고 했다. 다만 “국민의힘이 들어오기 전에도 법안 심사는 시작하겠다”고 했다.)

Lee Joo-hee, the Democratic Party’s floor spokesperson, also said, “After the TF meeting on the Criminal Procedure Act revision at 2 p.m. today, the TF bill is likely to be proposed today.” She added, “The Legislation and Judiciary Committee meets tomorrow, and we will begin discussions in the subcommittee on bills, covering the extension of the special counsel’s deadline and the already proposed Criminal Procedure Act bills. It seems unlikely a conclusion will be reached tomorrow.” She further stated, “After reporting the discussion process and content to the general meeting of lawmakers, we will decide whether to adopt it as a party line.” (이주희 민주당 원내대변인도 “오늘 오후 2시 형사소송법 개정 TF 회의를 거친 뒤 오늘 중 TF 안을 발의하게 될 것 같다”고 했다. 이 원내대변인은 “내일 법사위가 열리는데 종합특검 기한 연장과 기발의된 형소법 안들을 갖고 법안소위에서 논의를 시작할 것 같다”며 “내일 당장 결론이 나기는 어려울 것 같다”고 했다. 이어 “의총에서 논의 과정과 내용을 충분히 보고한 뒤 당론으로 채택할지 여부를 결정하게 될 것 같다”고 했다.)

The Democratic Party maintains that revising the Criminal Procedure Act is necessary ahead of the launch of the separate investigation and prosecution system in October. Floor spokesperson Lee said, “The revision of the Criminal Procedure Act has a deadline. It is essential for the investigation and prosecution agencies to launch in a separated form in October.” She added, “We will prepare robust alternatives to ensure the public does not worry about the various side effects that may arise from abolishing supplementary investigation rights and the recent situation. We will deliberate thoroughly in that process.” (민주당은 오는 10월 수사·기소 분리 체계 출범을 앞두고 형사소송법 개정이 필요하다는 입장이다. 이 원내대변인은 “형소법 개정은 시한이 있다”며 “10월에 본격적으로 분리된 형태로 수사·기소 기관이 출범하려면 반드시 필요하다”고 했다. 그는 “보완수사권 폐지 뒤 나올 수 있는 여러 부작용과 최근 사태로 인해 국민이 우려하는 상황에 대해 걱정하지 않도록 충실한 대안을 마련하겠다”며 “그 과정에서 충분히 숙의하겠다”고 했다.)

The People Power Party is criticizing the abolition of supplementary investigation rights as “complete police monopoly over investigation rights.” With cautious voices emerging even within the Democratic Party over the full abolition of supplementary investigation rights following the Jang Yun-gi case, the review of the Criminal Procedure Act amendment is expected to lead to conflict between the ruling and opposition parties over control mechanisms for police investigations and victim protection measures. (국민의힘은 보완수사권 폐지를 “경수완독, 즉 경찰 수사권 완전 독점”이라고 비판하고 있다. 민주당 내부에서도 장윤기 사건을 계기로 보완수사권 전면 폐지에 대한 신중론이 제기되는 상황에서, 형사소송법 개정안 심사는 경찰 수사에 대한 통제 장치와 피해자 보호 대책을 둘러싼 여야 충돌로 이어질 전망이다.)

In the Jang Yun-gi case, allegations have repeatedly surfaced that the police investigation was shoddy in securing key evidence and forwarding the case. It has been reported that police discovered a damaged sex doll at Jang’s residence but did not preserve it, and did not hand over the DNA analysis report of the doll to the prosecution at the time of case transfer. Jang’s vehicle was returned to his father after basic inspection, and the cable ties that could support the motive of sexual assault were reportedly not secured in time. (장윤기 사건에서는 경찰 수사 과정의 핵심 증거 확보와 송치가 부실했다는 의혹이 잇따라 제기됐다. 경찰은 장윤기의 자취방에서 훼손된 리얼돌을 발견하고도 실물을 보전하지 않았고, 리얼돌 DNA 감식 보고서도 사건 송치 당시 검찰에 넘기지 않은 것으로 알려졌다. 장윤기의 차량은 기본 감식 뒤 부친에게 반환됐고, 성폭행 목적 범행 정황을 뒷받침할 수 있는 케이블타이도 제때 확보되지 않은 것으로 전해졌다.)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk Draws the Disciplinary Sword... Appoints One Additional Member to People Power Party Ethics Committee (징계 칼 빼든 장동혁... 국힘 윤리위원 1명 추가 임명)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk Draws the Disciplinary Sword... Appoints One Additional Member to People Power Party Ethics Committee (징계 칼 빼든 장동혁... 국힘 윤리위원 1명 추가 임명)

As People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk emphasizes "establishing party discipline" and moves to reactivate the Central Ethics Committee, the party appointed one additional ethics committee member on the 9th. In addition, the party retained the media spokesperson who had been embroiled in the "Yoon Again" controversy. (국민의힘 장동혁 대표가 ‘당의 기강 확립’을 강조하며 중앙윤리위원회 재가동에 돌입한 가운데 국민의힘이 9일 윤리위원 1명을 추가 임명했다. 이 밖에 ‘윤 어게인’ 논란이 있던 미디어대변인을 유임시켰다.)

People Power Party Senior Spokesperson Choi Bo-yoon told reporters after a closed-door Supreme Council meeting that day, "We have appointed one additional member to the central party's Ethics Committee." With this, the Ethics Committee, which had consisted of six members including Chairperson Yoon Min-woo, is reported to have expanded to seven. According to the party constitution and regulations, the party can form an Ethics Committee of up to nine members. (국민의힘 최보윤 수석대변인은 이날 비공개 최고위원회의가 끝난 뒤 기자들과 만나 “중앙당 윤리위원 1명을 추가로 임명했다”고 밝혔다. 이를 통해 윤민우 윤리위원장을 포함해 총 6명이었던 윤리위가 7명으로 늘어난 것으로 전해졌다. 당헌·당규에 따르면 당은 윤리위를 9인 이내로 구성할 수 있다.)

The additional appointment of an ethics committee member coincides with the recent reactivation of the Ethics Committee, which had been paused during the local elections. When asked about the background of the selection, Senior Spokesperson Choi said, "Ethics committee disciplinary reviews had been halted before the local elections, and it is natural and necessary for the committee to convene after the elections in accordance with party members' demands and the party constitution and regulations." He added, "Nine is the maximum number that can be appointed, so there was a consensus within the Supreme Council for the additional appointment, and it was approved by the Supreme Council." (윤리위원 추가 임명은 지방선거 기간 잠시 멈춰 있던 윤리위가 최근 재가동된 것과 맞물려 이뤄졌다. 최 수석대변인은 인선 배경을 묻는 질문에 “지방선거 이전에 윤리위 징계(심의)가 멈춰 있었고, 당원들의 요구나 당헌·당규에 따라 윤리위가 지선 이후 열리는 건 자연스럽고 필요한 절차”라며 “9명이 (임명 가능한) 최대 인원이니 최고위에서 (추가 임명에) 공감대가 있었고, 최고위 의결로 임명한 것”이라고 말했다.)

The newly appointed ethics committee member is reported to be a legal professional. One Supreme Council member explained, "There was a consensus among Supreme Council members that there should be no more cases where disciplinary decisions made by the Ethics Committee in March were overturned by courts. To prevent similar issues from recurring, a legal professional was additionally appointed." It is known that only Supreme Council member Woo Jae-joon voiced concerns during the closed-door Supreme Council meeting that day. (이번에 임명된 윤리위원은 법조인으로 알려졌다. 한 최고위원은 “지난 3월 윤리위에서 내린 징계 결정이 법원에서 번복된 사례가 또 있어서는 안 된다는 최고위원들 사이 공감대가 있었다”며 “비슷한 문제가 다시는 발생하지 않도록 법조인을 추가로 임명한 것”이라고 설명했다. 이날 비공개 최고위에선 우재준 최고위원만 우려의 목소리를 전달한 것으로 알려졌다.)

The People Power Party Ethics Committee is known to have held its first meeting after the local elections on the 6th to review disciplinary motions. However, it is reported that the committee did not decide whether to begin disciplinary proceedings at that meeting. (국민의힘 윤리위는 지난 6일 지방선거 이후 첫 회의를 열고 징계안을 심의한 것으로 알려졌다. 다만 이날 회의에선 징계 개시 여부를 결정하지 않았다고 한다.)

Meanwhile, Party Leader Jang Dong-hyuk reinforced the spokesperson team through the Supreme Council that day. Spokespersons Ham In-kyung and Media Spokesperson Lee Ji-ae, whose terms had expired, were retained, and Bong Seong-beom, who previously served as the Incheon City Civil Communication Officer and Policy Chief, was newly appointed as Media Spokesperson. (한편 장동혁 대표는 이날 최고위를 거쳐 대변인단을 일부 보강했다. 임기가 만료된 함인경 대변인과 이지애 미디어대변인은 유임하고 인천시 시민소통담당관과 정책수석을 지낸 봉성범 미디어대변인을 새로 임명했다.)

The retained Media Spokesperson Lee Ji-ae, a former news anchor, had faced criticism as a "Yoon Again" appointment. In December of last year, around the one-year mark of the martial law declaration, she said on her YouTube channel, "Thank you, sir (former President Yoon), for waking us from our slumber. You are our president." (이번에 유임된 이지애 미디어대변인은 아나운서 출신으로 ‘윤 어게인’ 인사라는 비판을 받았었다. 그는 작년 12월 계엄 1년 당시 자신의 유튜브 채널에서 “우리를 잠에서 깨워준 당신(윤 전 대통령)께 감사드린다. 우리의 대통령은 당신입니다”라고 했다.)

After the recent local elections, when some argued that Leader Jang should resign, taking responsibility for the election defeat, she publicly defended him, stating, "That is a denial of the choices made by party members and the people." (그는 지난 지방선거 이후 일각에서 선거 패배의 책임을 지고 장 대표가 사퇴해야 한다는 주장이 나오자 “이는 당원과 국민의 선택을 부정하는 주장”이라고 장 대표를 공개적으로 두둔하기도 했다.)

item.title: Football Association Hearing to Be Held on the 22nd... Witnesses Hong Myung-bo, Reference Person Son Heung-min (축구협 청문회 22일 열린다... 증인 홍명보, 참고인 손흥민)
item.description:
Football Association Hearing to Be Held on the 22nd... Witnesses Hong Myung-bo, Reference Person Son Heung-min (축구협 청문회 22일 열린다... 증인 홍명보, 참고인 손흥민)

The National Assembly's Culture, Sports and Tourism Committee has decided to hold a hearing on pending issues of the Korea Football Association on the 22nd. The aim is to examine at the parliamentary level the process of appointing the national team coach and the operational issues of the football association, which have been raised after the elimination in the group stage of the 2026 North and Central America World Cup. (국회 문화체육관광위원회가 오는 22일 대한축구협회 현안 청문회를 열기로 했다. 2026 북중미 월드컵 조별리그 탈락 이후 제기된 대표팀 감독 선임 과정과 축구협회 운영 문제를 국회 차원에서 따져보겠다는 취지다.)

The Culture, Sports and Tourism Committee held a plenary session on the 9th and voted on the adoption of a plan to hold a hearing on pending issues related to the Korea Football Association. The meeting was held with the People Power Party absent, in protest against the Democratic Party unilaterally electing chairpersons for 11 standing and special committees. (문체위는 9일 전체회의를 열고 ‘대한축구협회 현안 관련 청문회 실시계획서 채택의 건’을 의결했다. 이날 회의는 더불어민주당이 11개 상임·특위 위원장을 단독 선출한 데 반발해 국민의힘이 불참한 가운데 열렸다.)

Lee Jae-jung, chairperson of the Culture, Sports and Tourism Committee from the Democratic Party, said at the meeting, "We will inspect various issues that have emerged in the process of appointing the national football team coach and the overall operational status of the Korea Football Association at the parliamentary level and seek ways to normalize the association." (민주당 소속 이재정 문체위원장은 회의에서 “축구 국가대표팀 감독 선임 절차와 대한축구협회의 운영 실태 전반에 나타난 여러 문제점을 국회 차원에서 점검하고 협회 정상화 방안을 모색하겠다”고 했다.)

Democratic Party lawmaker Lee Jung-moon, who was appointed as the ruling party secretary, also said, "The public's disappointment and concern are very great due to the situation surrounding the football association," adding, "The Culture, Sports and Tourism Committee will take the lead in driving reform to restore fairness and trust in sports administration overall." (여당 간사로 선임된 민주당 이정문 의원도 “축구협회를 둘러싼 사태로 국민적 실망과 우려가 매우 크다”며 “체육 행정 전반의 공정성과 신뢰를 바로 세우도록 문체위가 중심이 돼 개혁을 이끌겠다”고 했다.)

The Culture, Sports and Tourism Committee also adopted 13 witnesses and 10 reference persons for the hearing. The list of witnesses includes Korea Football Association President Chung Mong-gyu, former national team coach Hong Myung-bo, former association technical director Lee Im-saeng, association vice president Lee Yong-soo, former national team reinforcement committee chairman Jung Hae-sung, association executive director Kim Seung-hee, and former association vice presidents Choi Young-il and Park Hang-seo. (문체위는 청문회 증인 13명과 참고인 10명도 채택했다. 증인 명단에는 정몽규 대한축구협회장, 홍명보 전 축구대표팀 감독, 이임생 전 협회 기술총괄이사, 이용수 축구협회 부회장, 정해성 전 국가대표 전력강화위원장, 김승희 축구협회 전무이사, 최영일·박항서 전 축구협회 부회장 등이 포함됐다.)

Reference persons include Park Ji-sung, a FIFA committee member serving as co-chair of the "K-Football Innovation Committee," Korean Sport & Olympic Committee President Yoo Seung-min, and innovation committee members and commentators Lee Young-pyo and Park Joo-ho. Son Heung-min (LAFC) and Hwang Hee-chan (Wolverhampton), who participated in the 2026 North and Central America World Cup, were also included on the list of reference persons. (참고인으로는 ‘K-축구 혁신위원회’ 공동위원장인 박지성 국제축구연맹(FIFA) 분과위원회 위원과 유승민 대한체육회장, 혁신위원인 이영표·박주호 해설위원 등이 채택됐다. 2026 북중미 월드컵에 출전했던 손흥민(LAFC), 황희찬(울버햄프턴)도 참고인 명단에 올랐다.)

However, it is unclear whether both the witnesses and reference persons will attend the hearing. Democratic Party lawmaker Jo Kae-won said at the meeting, "There is a high possibility that key individuals such as former President Chung and former Coach Hong will avoid attending, as they have been resigning one after another and fleeing abroad." (다만 증인과 참고인이 모두 청문회에 출석할지는 불투명하다. 민주당 조계원 의원은 회의에서 “정 전 회장과 홍 전 감독 등 핵심 당사자들이 줄줄이 사임하고 외국으로 도피하는 등의 행보를 보여 출석 요구를 회피할 가능성이 크다”고 했다.)

The hearing is expected to focus on issues such as the appointment process for former coach Jurgen Klinsmann and former coach Hong Myung-bo, the decision-making structure of the football association, and suspicions of so-called "backroom operations." (청문회에서는 위르겐 클린스만 전 감독과 홍명보 전 감독의 선임 과정, 축구협회의 의사 결정 구조, 이른바 ‘밀실 운영’ 의혹 등이 주요 쟁점이 될 전망이다.)

According to the audit results of the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism, the function of the National Team Reinforcement Committee was effectively neutralized during the appointment process of former coach Klinsmann in February 2023. It was also found that during the subsequent appointment of former coach Hong, Lee Im-saeng, then technical director with no authority over coach appointments, recommended candidates, and the interview process was conducted opaquely. (문화체육관광부 감사 결과에 따르면 2023년 2월 클린스만 전 감독 선임 과정에서는 국가대표전력강화위원회의 기능이 사실상 무력화된 것으로 조사됐다. 이후 홍 전 감독 선임 때도 감독 선임 권한이 없는 이임생 당시 기술총괄이사가 후보를 추천하고, 면접 절차도 불투명하게 진행된 것으로 나타났다.)

This hearing is expected to be a session to hold the football association accountable for its operations and simultaneously discuss measures to restore trust in sports administration overall following the World Cup elimination. However, given that the hearing schedule and witness list were adopted by the ruling party alone with the People Power Party absent, political confrontations are also anticipated during the hearing process. (이번 청문회는 축구협회 운영 책임을 묻는 자리인 동시에, 월드컵 탈락 이후 체육 행정 전반의 신뢰 회복 방안을 논의하는 자리가 될 것으로 보인다. 다만 국민의힘이 불참한 상태에서 여당 단독으로 청문회 일정과 증인 명단이 의결된 만큼, 청문회 운영 과정에서 정치적 공방도 예상된다.)

item.title: Meritz Says "Will Recover All Store Sale Proceeds" While Rejecting Ruling Party's Proposal for Homeplus Emergency Funds (메리츠 “점포 매각대금 전부 회수” 與 홈플러스 긴급운영자금 제안 거부)
item.description:
Meritz Says "Will Recover All Store Sale Proceeds" While Rejecting Ruling Party's Proposal for Homeplus Emergency Funds (메리츠 “점포 매각대금 전부 회수” 與 홈플러스 긴급운영자금 제안 거부)

On the 9th, the Democratic Party of Korea urged MBK Partners, the major shareholder, and Meritz Financial Group, the largest creditor, to promptly secure emergency operating funds in response to the Homeplus bankruptcy crisis. However, Meritz Financial reportedly effectively rejected a proposal to use proceeds from Homeplus store sales as emergency operating funds. (더불어민주당은 9일 홈플러스 파산 위기 사태와 관련, 대주주 MBK파트너스와 최대 채권자 메리츠금융그룹을 향해 긴급 운영자금을 조속히 마련하라고 촉구했다. 하지만 메리츠금융은 홈플러스의 점포 매각대금을 긴급 운영자금으로 활용하는 방안에 대해서도 사실상 거부 입장을 밝힌 것으로 전해졌다.)

Kim Nam-geun, a Democratic Party lawmaker affiliated with the Euljiro Committee, met with reporters after holding the "MBK Partners-Meritz Management Meeting for Homeplus Rehabilitation" and the "National Pension Service Chairman Meeting for Homeplus Rehabilitation" at the National Assembly the same day. He stated, "Among the 37 stores scheduled for closure, three stores are available for sale, with sale proceeds totaling approximately 230 billion won. Of this, only the proceeds from two stores with already signed contracts amount to around 170 billion won." (민주당 을지로위원회 소속 김남근 민주당 의원은 이날 국회에서 열린 ‘홈플러스 회생을 위한 MBK파트너스-메리츠 경영진 간담회’와 ‘홈플러스 회생을 위한 국민연금공단 이사장 간담회’를 연 뒤 기자들과 만나 “폐점 예정인 37개 점포 가운데 매각 가능한 점포 3곳의 매각대금은 약 2300억원 규모이며, 이 가운데 이미 매매계약이 체결된 2곳의 대금만 약 1700억원 수준”이라고 했다.)

Lawmaker Kim said, "We requested Meritz to allow part of these proceeds to be used as emergency operating funds for Homeplus." He continued, "Since these emergency funds are legally prioritized for repayment, they are also of a nature that can protect Meritz's interests. However, despite explaining this point, Meritz took a stance of 'taking everything' with logic that is hard to accept." (김 의원은 “이 가운데 일부를 홈플러스의 긴급 운영자금으로 사용할 수 있도록 하는 방안을 메리츠 측에 요구했다”고 했다. 그는 “긴급 운영자금은 법적으로도 최우선 변제를 받는 자금인 만큼 메리츠 입장에서도 보호받을 수 있는 성격”이라며 “그런 점을 설명했지만 메리츠는 납득하기 어려운 논리로 ‘다 가져가겠다’는 입장을 보였다”고 했다.)

According to Kim, 19 of the 37 stores targeted for closure are owned by Homeplus. With the sale proceeds from the two already contracted stores alone securing about 170 billion won, the Euljiro Committee believes there is room to use some of it for operating funds. (김 의원에 따르면 현재 폐점 대상 37개 점포 가운데 19개는 홈플러스 소유 점포다. 이 가운데 이미 계약이 체결된 2개 점포 매각대금만으로도 약 1700억원이 확보되는 만큼, 일부를 운영자금으로 사용할 여지가 있다는 것이 을지로위원회 입장이다.)

However, Meritz reportedly maintained its position that even if it agrees to the sale under the premise of rehabilitation proceedings, the entire sale proceeds must be used for debt recovery. MBK and Homeplus argue that the largest creditor Meritz's support is necessary to raise emergency operating funds of 200 billion won. (그러나 메리츠는 이날 회생절차를 전제로 매각에 동의하더라도 매각대금은 전액 채권 회수에 사용돼야 한다는 입장을 유지한 것으로 알려졌다. MBK와 홈플러스는 긴급운영자금 2000억원 조달을 위해 최대 채권자인 메리츠의 지원이 필요하다는 입장이다.)

Kim stated, "Meritz expressed that it would only agree to further sales on the condition that all proceeds are recovered by them. This matter requires further discussion." (김 의원은 “앞으로 추가 매각이 이뤄져도 전부 메리츠가 회수하는 조건으로만 동의하겠다는 입장을 표명했다”며 “이 부분은 앞으로도 논의가 필요하다”고 했다.)

Committee Chairman Byung-duk Min said at the meeting, "About 100 billion won in emergency operating funds is needed," and added, "Meritz and MBK management, in their positions as creditors and investors, must fulfill their rightful social responsibilities. I earnestly request this." The Euljiro Committee also announced plans to push for a parliamentary hearing involving Meritz and MBK. (민병덕 위원장은 이날 간담회에서 “긴급 운영자금 1천억 원 정도가 필요하다”며 “메리츠와 MBK경영진은 채권자, 투자자의 지위로 마땅히 짊어져야 할 사회적인 책임을 다해주시길 정중히 요청한다”고 했다. 을지로위원회는 메리츠와 MBK에 대한 국회 청문회도 추진하겠다는 입장이다.)

item.title: Former U.S. National Security Advisor: "The Kim Dynasty in North Korea Is Heading Toward Its End" (전 美국가안보보좌관 “北 김씨 왕조 종말 향해 가고 있다”)
item.description:
Former U.S. National Security Advisor: "The Kim Dynasty in North Korea Is Heading Toward Its End" (전 美국가안보보좌관 “北 김씨 왕조 종말 향해 가고 있다” )

Former White House National Security Advisor Michael Flynn stated on the 9th that "the Kim Dynasty is coming to an end." (마이클 플린 전 백악관 국가안보보좌관은 “김씨 왕조는 종말을 향해 가고 있다(Kim Dynasty is coming to an end)”고 9일 말했다.)

Flynn, who served as National Security Advisor in the first Trump administration, made these remarks while attending a forum hosted by the Korea-U.S. Alliance Foundation in Seoul that morning. The retired U.S. Army Brigadier General and former advisor said, "Kim Jong-un has health issues," adding, "We need to foresee and prepare for what will happen when this dynasty ends." Flynn also emphasized, "We must prevent North Korea's nuclear technology from spreading to countries like Pakistan, Iran, and Syria." (트럼프 1기 행정부에서 국가안보보좌관을 지낸 그는 이날 오전 한미동맹재단이 서울에서 연 포럼에 참석해 이같이 말했다. 예비역 미 육군 준장인 플린 전 보좌관은 “김정은은 건강 문제가 있다”며 “이 왕조가 끝나면 어떤 일이 벌어질지 미리 내다보고 대비해야 한다”고 했다. 플린 전 보좌관은 이어 “북한의 핵기술이 파키스탄·이란·시리아 등으로 확산되는 것을 막아야 한다”고도 했다.)

Regarding discussions in South Korean society about developing its own nuclear weapons, he stated, "If I were in your position, I might wonder whether I would want to have nuclear capabilities," but added, "What South Korea truly needs for the entire region is the strong 'nuclear umbrella' provided by the United States." He further noted, "Uranium enrichment (to obtain nuclear weapons material) is very dangerous and will cause tensions among countries in the region." This was interpreted as a call for South Korea to continue trusting the U.S. nuclear umbrella, as developing its own nuclear weapons could lead to heightened tensions, including regional nuclear proliferation. (한국 사회에서 나오는 자체 핵무장론에 대해서는 “내가 여러분 입장이었다면 핵 능력을 가지길 원할지 모르겠다”며 “한국이 지역 전체를 위해 정말로 필요로 하는 것은 미국이 제공하는 강력한 ‘핵우산’”이라고 했다. 그러면서 “(핵무기 원료를 얻기 위한) 우라늄 농축 등은 매우 위험하고 역내 국가 간의 긴장을 초래할 것”이라고 덧붙였다. 한국의 자체 핵개발 등은 역내 핵 확산 등 다른 긴장 고조 상황으로 이어질 수 있으니 지금처럼 미국의 핵우산을 신뢰하라는 뜻으로 이해됐다.)

On the issue of transitioning wartime operational control (OPCON), Flynn remarked, "Transferring operational control on the battlefield is probably the most delicate task," and said that before making a decision on OPCON transition, "there must be a series of decision-making processes involving multiple rounds of exercises." He cautioned, "It should not be a decision made suddenly, like pulling something out of a back pocket and saying, 'Let's do it now.'" He added, "Major global powers like China and Russia will be watching, looking for signs of weakness." (전시작전통제권(전작권) 전환과 관련해서는 “전장에서의 작전통제권 전환은 아마도 가장 섬세한 작업일 것”이라며 전작권 전환 결정 이전에 “여러 차례 연습을 거친 일련의 의사결정 과정”이 있어야 한다고 했다. 플린 전 보좌관은 “뒷주머니에서 갑자기 꺼내듯이 ‘이제 그렇게 하자’고 결정하는 식이어서는 안 된다”며 그러면서 “중국·러시아 등 세계 주요국들이 지켜보며 약점의 징후를 찾으려고 할 것”이라고 했다.)

Flynn served for a long time in the fields of intelligence and special operations and held the position of Director of the U.S. Defense Intelligence Agency (DIA). He served as the first National Security Advisor in the Trump administration but was forced to resign less than a month into his term amid allegations of improper contacts with Russia. Currently, he serves as the chairman of the think tank "The Gold Institute." (플린은 정보와 특수전 분야에서 오랫동안 근무하고 미 국방부 국방정보국(DIA) 국장을 지냈다. 그는 트럼프 1기 행정부 초대 국가안보보좌관을 맡았지만, 러시아와의 내통 의혹에 휘말려 취임 1달도 채우지 못하고 물러났다. 현재는 싱크탱크 ‘골드 인스티튜트’ 이사장으로 활동하고 있다.)

Im Ho-young, Chairman of the Korea-U.S. Alliance Foundation, stated that day, "In the 70-plus years before the signing of the Mutual Defense Treaty between the United States and the Republic of Korea in 1953, the Korean Peninsula experienced six wars: the First Sino-Japanese War, the Russo-Japanese War, the Mukden Incident, the Second Sino-Japanese War, the Pacific War, and the Korean War." He added, "In the 70-plus years since the Korea-U.S. alliance, there has been no war on the peninsula, and this has served as the foundation for economic development and democratization." He further emphasized, "The most important thing in an alliance is trust," saying, "Even if there are conflicts with the other side, we must speak honestly and work to resolve the problems. We should not hide (conflicts) or tell lies." <<>> (임호영 한미동맹재단 이사장은 이날 “한미상호방위조약이 체결된 1953년 이전 70여년 동안 한반도는 청일전쟁·러일전쟁·만주사변·중일전쟁·태평양전쟁·6·25전쟁 등 6차례나 전쟁을 겪었다”며 “한미동맹 이후 70여년 동안 한반도에서 전쟁은 없었고 이를 토대로 경제발전과 민주화를 이뤄냈다”고 했다. 그러면서 “동맹에서 가장 중요한 것은 신뢰”라며 “상대방과 갈등이 있더라도 솔직하게 이야기하고 문제를 해결해 나가야 된다. (갈등을) 숨기거나 거짓말을 이야기해서는 안 된다”고 했다.)

item.title: Convention Preparation Committee Refutes Pro-Cheonggye Faction... "Preferential Voting System Does Not Violate Party Constitution or Regulations" (與전대준비위, 친청계에 반박... “선호투표제, 당헌·당규 위반 아니다”)
item.description:
Convention Preparation Committee Refutes Pro-Cheonggye Faction... "Preferential Voting System Does Not Violate Party Constitution or Regulations" (與전대준비위, 친청계에 반박... “선호투표제, 당헌·당규 위반 아니다”)

The Democratic Party of Korea's Convention Preparation Committee stated on the 9th regarding the preferential voting system set to be introduced for the August 17 party convention's leadership election that "the committee finds it difficult to view this as a violation of the party constitution or regulations." The committee maintained its existing stance despite backlash from the pro-Jung Cheong-rae faction, which argued that the system violated party rules following the committee's decision to adopt it. (더불어민주당 전당대회준비위원회(전준위)는 9일 8·17 전당대회 당대표 선거에 도입하기로 한 선호투표제와 관련해 “전준위에서는 당헌·당규 위반으로 보기 어렵다는 의견”이라고 밝혔다. 앞서 전준위가 선호투표제를 의결하자 친정청래계에서 “당헌·당규 위반”이라며 반발했으나 기존 입장을 유지한 것이다.)

Lee Yeon-hee, a Democratic Party lawmaker serving as the committee's spokesperson, conveyed this after a meeting with reporters at the National Assembly, saying, "Today, the committee's planning subcommittee reported on related matters, and the majority opinion within the committee was that it is hard to see this as a violation of the party constitution or regulations." (전준위 대변인을 맡은 이연희 민주당 의원은 이날 국회에서 회의 후 기자들과 만나 “오늘 전준위 기획분과에서 관련한 사항에 대해 보고했고, 전준위 내에서는 당헌·당규 위반으로 보기 어렵다는 의견이 다수였다”며 이같이 전했다.)

She added, "No one raised objections to the preferential voting system itself; the claims of violations of the party constitution emerged only after the decision was made. The authority to interpret the party constitution and regulations lies with the Party Affairs Committee." (그는 “선호투표제에 대해 이의를 제기한 분은 없었고, 의결되고 나서 당헌 위반에 대한 의견들이 있었던 것”이라며 “당헌·당규 해석 권한은 당무위에 있다”고 했다.)

However, the party's Supreme Council has not yet voted on this matter. If the Supreme Council rejects the implementation of the preferential voting system, the Convention Preparation Committee will need to revisit the voting method. The Democratic Party plans to hold a closed-door Supreme Council meeting as early as this afternoon to further discuss related matters. (다만 민주당 최고위에서 아직 해당 내용에 대한 의결이 이뤄지지 않았다. 최고위에서 선호투표제 시행이 부결될 경우 전준위에서 투표 방법에 대해 다시 논의해야 한다. 민주당은 이르면 이날 오후 비공개 최고위원회의를 열어 관련 사항을 추가 논의할 예정이다.)

The preferential voting system allows voters to rank candidates as first, second, third, and so on. If no candidate secures a majority of first-preference votes, the lowest-ranked candidate is eliminated, and their votes are redistributed to the next preferred candidates. (선호투표제는 각 후보에게 1순위, 2순위, 3순위 등으로 투표하고, 개표에서 1순위 과반 후보가 나오지 않을 경우 최하위를 떨어뜨리고 해당 후보 표의 차순위 후보에게 합산하는 방식이다.)

Following the committee's decision, pro-Cheonggye Supreme Council members like Lee Seong-yoon and Moon Jeong-bok have opposed it, arguing it violates the party constitution and regulations. Conversely, other party leadership contenders, including former Prime Minister Kim Min-seok and lawmaker Song Young-gil, assert that it does not breach party rules and that the committee's decision should be followed. (전준위가 선호투표제를 의결하자 이성윤·문정복 최고위원 등 친청계는 당헌·당규 위반이라며 반발하고 있다. 반면 김민석 전 총리와 송영길 의원 등 다른 당권 주자 측은 당헌·당규 위반이 아니며 전준위 결정을 따라야 한다고 주장하고 있다.)

item.title: Oh Se-hoon: "The Democratic Party's obsession with abolishing supplementary investigation powers must be stopped by President Lee" (오세훈 “與검수완박 집착, 李대통령이 제동 걸어야")
item.description:
Oh Se-hoon: "The Democratic Party's obsession with abolishing supplementary investigation powers must be stopped by President Lee" (오세훈 “與검수완박 집착, 李대통령이 제동 걸어야")

Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon said on the 9th regarding the Democratic Party of Korea's push to abolish the prosecution's supplementary investigation powers, "The end of completely stripping the prosecution of investigative powers is the collapse of people's livelihoods," adding, "President Lee Jae-myung must put a brake on this." (오세훈 서울시장은 9일 더불어민주당이 추진하는 검찰 보완 수사권 폐지에 대해 “검수완박(검찰 수사권 완전 박탈)의 끝은 민생 파탄”이라며 “이재명 대통령이 제동을 걸어야 한다”고 했다.)

On Facebook that day, Mayor Oh stated, "If the Democratic Party forces through the bill to abolish supplementary investigation powers in a plenary session, I ask the President to immediately prepare to exercise the right to request reconsideration." He added, "If the end of such excesses is the collapse of people's livelihoods, then the President, as the head of the administration and the final responsible party, must use all constitutional authority to apply the brakes." (오 시장은 이날 페이스북에 “민주당이 (보완 수사권 폐지 법안을) 본회의에서 강행 처리한다면, 대통령이 즉시 재의 요구권 행사를 준비해달라”면서 이같이 밝혔다. 그러면서 “이런 폭주의 끝이 민생 파탄이라면, 행정부 수반이자 최종 책임자인 대통령이 헌법적 권한을 총동원해 브레이크를 걸어야 한다”고도 했다.)

Regarding the supplementary investigation powers, Mayor Oh said, "Just as you can't entrust your body to a surgery room where the surgeon enters alone, judicial justice also absolutely requires cross-checks," adding, "Checks are necessary to correct errors and prevent wrongful harm." (보완 수사권과 관련해서 오 시장은 “집도의 혼자 들어가는 수술실에 몸을 맡길 수 없듯, 사법 정의에도 반드시 크로스체크가 필요하다”며 “견제가 있어야 오류를 바로잡고 억울한 피해도 막을 수 있는 것”이라고 했다.)

He further stated, "If this minimum safety net collapses, the damage will directly hit the lives of ordinary citizens," and "The police and prosecution will play a 'legal ping-pong' of shifting responsibility, and criminals will gain months of investigation gaps to destroy evidence." (그러면서 “이 같은 최소한의 안전판이 무너지면 그 피해는 고스란히 평범한 시민들의 삶으로 들이닥친다”며 “검경이 책임 떠넘기는 ‘합법적 핑퐁’을 할 것이고 범죄자들은 수사 공백의 몇 달 동안 증거 인멸할 시간을 벌게 된다”고 했다.)

On the Democratic Party unilaterally pushing the bill to abolish the prosecution's supplementary investigation powers, he said, "Is the Republic of Korea's Criminal Procedure Act a subcontract bill that must be hastily tinkered with to fit a specific party's 'political clock'?" adding, "The judicial system, directly linked to the lives of the people, must not be reduced to a convention planning product of a specific party." This was a criticism of the behavior of Democratic Party leadership candidates competing to advocate for the abolition of supplementary investigation powers. (민주당이 검찰 보완 수사권 폐지 법안을 일방적으로 밀어붙이는 데 대해선 “대한민국 형사소송법이 특정 정당의 ‘정치 시계’에 맞춰 번갯불에 콩 볶듯 뜯어고쳐야 하는 하청 법안이냐”면서 “국민의 생명과 직결된 사법 제도가 특정 정당의 전당대회 기획 상품으로 전락해서는 안 될 것”이라고 했다. 민주당 당대표 후보들이 앞다퉈 보완 수사권 폐지를 주장하는 행태를 지적한 것이다.)

Mayor Oh said, "In recent cases like the Gwangju high school girl murder case and the former Donghae mayor bribery case, there were shortcomings in the initial investigations, but because of the prosecution's supplementary investigations, we were able to get closer to the substantive truth." He continued, "What the people want is a country where crimes are properly uncovered, victims are protected to the end, and no one is wronged," adding, "That is the reason the judicial system exists." (오 시장은 “최근 광주 여고생 살인 사건이나 전 동해시장 뇌물 사건 등은 초기 수사에서 부실함이 있었지만, 검찰의 보완 수사가 있었기에 실체적 진실에 다가갈 수 있었다”고 했다. 이어 “국민이 원하는 것은 범죄는 제대로 밝혀지고, 피해자가 끝까지 보호받고 억울한 사람이 없는 나라”라며 “그것이 사법제도가 존재하는 이유”라고 했다.)

item.title: Kim Woong: "Abolishing Prosecution's Supplementary Investigation Rights Means Burying Poorly Investigated Cases... Only the Victims Suffer" (김웅 “檢 보완수사권 폐지, 부실수사 사건 묻으란 얘기...피해자만 억울”)
item.description:
Kim Woong: "Abolishing Prosecution's Supplementary Investigation Rights Means Burying Poorly Investigated Cases... Only the Victims Suffer" (김웅 “檢 보완수사권 폐지, 부실수사 사건 묻으란 얘기...피해자만 억울”)

Kim Woong, a former lawmaker of the People Power Party and a former chief prosecutor, criticized the Democratic Party's push to pass a revision to the Criminal Procedure Act abolishing the prosecution's supplementary investigation rights, calling it "a situation like a blind ox following the sound of its own bell." (부장검사 출신인 김웅 전 국민의힘 의원은 더불어민주당이 검찰의 보완수사권 폐지를 위한 형사소송법 개정안의 국회 처리를 밀어붙이는 것에 대해 “눈먼 소가 자기 워낭 소리를 듣고 따라가는 상황”이라고 비판했다.)

In an interview with this newspaper on the 9th, the former lawmaker said, "The people in the Democratic Party pushing for so-called prosecution reform have never actually conducted an investigation themselves, so they seem unaware of what they're doing or what will happen." He added, "They are using supplementary investigations as a tool for internal power struggles without understanding how important they are. In the end, the victims are the ones who suffer." (김 전 의원은 9일 본지 인터뷰에서 “민주당에서 소위 검찰 개혁을 추진하는 사람들은 실제로 수사를 해본 적이 없어서 자기들이 무슨 일을 하는지, 어떤 일이 벌어질지 모르는 것 같다”며 이같이 말했다. 김 전 의원은 “보완 수사가 얼마나 중요한지 알지 못한 채 이를 내부 권력 투쟁의 도구로 삼는 것”이라며 “결국 피해는 피해자가 입게 된다”고 했다.)

()

-Why are supplementary investigation rights necessary? (-보완수사권은 왜 필요한가.)

"For example, suppose someone is sent to the prosecution on charges of 'nighttime home invasion theft.' For 'nighttime' home invasion to be established, the person must have entered someone else's home after sunset. But what if the suspect tells the prosecution, 'Around June or July last year, I entered the house at 7 PM'? In June, 7 PM is after sunset, but in July, it could be before sunset. The sentence completely changes depending on whether it was before or after sunset. Verifying this is what supplementary investigation is for. To conduct a supplementary investigation, you need to check surveillance cameras to confirm the person's activities at that time, review phone records, and confirm the sunset time. But the Democratic Party wants to prevent prosecutors from doing this supplementary investigation." (“예를 들어 ‘야간 주거침입 절도죄’로 검찰에 송치된 사람이 있다고 치자. ‘야간’ 주거침입이 성립하려면 일몰 이후에 남의 집에 들어갔어야 한다. 그런데 범인이 검찰에서 ‘작년 6월인가 7월쯤 저녁 7시에 집에 들어갔다’고 얘기를 한다. 6월이면 저녁 7시가 일몰 이후인데, 7월이면 일몰 이전일 수 있다. 일몰 전인지 후인지에 따라 형량이 완전히 달라진다. 그걸 확인하는 게 보완수사다. 보완수사를 하려면 당시의 행적을 확인하기 위해 감시 카메라를 돌려보고, 휴대전화 사용 내역도 보고, 일몰 시간도 확인해 봐야 한다. 그런데 민주당은 검사가 그 보완수사를 못하게 하겠다는 것이다.)

-The ruling camp argues that retaining supplementary investigation rights could lead to fishing expeditions (investigating unrelated charges). (-여권에선 보완수사권을 남겨두면 별건수사가 이뤄질 수 있다고 주장한다.)

"Fishing expeditions are already impossible. Supplementary investigations can only be conducted within cases that maintain 'identity,' right? If a suspect is sent for nighttime home invasion theft, and checking their phone reveals photos of the victim taken secretly, that would constitute illegal filming under the Act on Special Cases Concerning the Punishment of Sexual Crimes. But that part cannot currently be investigated. The investigation must only relate to the nighttime home invasion theft charge. Supplementary investigations and fishing expeditions are completely different things." (“별건수사는 이미 할 수가 없게 돼 있다. ‘동일성’이 유지되는 사건 안에서만 보완수사를 할 수 있지 않나. 범인이 야간 주거침입 절도죄로 송치됐는데, 휴대전화를 확인해보니 피해자 모습을 도촬한 사진이 나왔다고 하자. 그럼 성폭력범죄처벌법상 불법 촬영 혐의가 있는 것이지만 그 부분은 지금 수사를 할 수 없게 돼 있다. 야간 주거 침입 절도 혐의와 관련해서만 수사해야 한다. 보완수사와 별건수사는 완전히 다른 것이다”)

-What about the argument that granting a right to request supplementary investigations would be sufficient? (-보완수사 요구권을 주면 되지 않느냐는 주장은 어떻게 보나.)

"The entire nation learned from the Jang Yun-gi case. If the police decide to botch an investigation entirely, there's no way around it. In the Jang Yun-gi case, the presence or absence of 'cable ties'—a restraint tool—made a huge difference. Simple murder carries the death penalty, life imprisonment, or at least five years in prison. But murder during rape under the Act on Special Cases Concerning the Punishment of Sexual Crimes carries only the death penalty or life imprisonment. The presence of cable ties indicates that it wasn't just murder but murder intended after sexual assault. Yet the person who removed the cable ties was the lead investigator. Telling them, 'Please check if there were cable ties,' is absurd. Arguing that a right to request supplementary investigations is sufficient is like saying to just bury the case." (“이번 장윤기 사건으로 모든 국민이 알게 됐다. 경찰이 사건을 아예 말아먹으려고 마음먹으면 방법이 없다. 장윤기 사건의 경우 결박 도구인 ‘케이블 타이’가 있냐 없냐가 정말 큰 차이를 만든다. 그냥 살인죄는 형량이 사형, 무기 또는 5년 이상의 징역이다. 그런데 성폭력범죄처벌법상 강간 등 살인은 사형 또는 무기징역만 있다. 케이블 타이가 있다는 건 그냥 살인이 아니라 성폭행 후 살인을 목적으로 했다는 얘기다. 그런데 케이블 타이를 없앤 사람이 담당 수사팀장인데, 그 사람에게 가서 ‘혹시 케이블 타이가 있었는지 확인해보세요’ 말한다? 보완수사 요구권으로 충분하다는 주장은 사건을 그냥 묻으라는 소리다.”)

-Are there side effects such as delays in case processing? (-사건 처리가 지연되는 등의 부작용도 있나.)

"Suppose a prosecutor finds an investigation insufficient and requests supplementary investigation from the police. If the police then sit on it for about ten days without investigating and send it back to the prosecution, the prosecutor, bound by statute of limitations for indictment, has no choice but to charge based on the charges applied by the police. In the end, victims suffer. Cases get buried and delayed in inefficiency, and only powerless, penniless victims end up wronged." (“검사가 수사가 부족하다고 보고 경찰에 보완수사 요구를 했다고 치자. 그런데 경찰이 열흘 정도 수사를 안 하고 있다가 다시 검찰에 돌려보냈다. 그럼 공소 제기 기간이 있으니까 검사는 어쩔 수 없이 경찰이 적용한 혐의로 기소할 수밖에 없다. 결국 피해는 피해자들이 본다. 사건이 묻히고 지연되는 비효율 속에 돈 없고 힘없는 피해자들만 억울해지는 것이다.”)

-Are there more examples showing the necessity of supplementary investigations? (-보완수사의 필요성을 보여주는 사례가 더 있나.)

"Supplementary investigations prevent many cases from being buried. In 2018, there was a case in Geoje where a man in his 20s indiscriminately beat an elderly person collecting scrap paper to death and was sent to the prosecution on charges of assault leading to death. With assault leading to death, if a settlement is reached with the victim's family, a suspended sentence is possible. But when the prosecutor reviewed the case, they found that the suspect had searched online for 'how to check if someone is dead,' and had focused his assault on the head, the most vulnerable part of the body, resulting in a murder charge. In the end, he got 35 years in prison. What would have happened if the prosecutor had just asked the police to do a supplementary investigation? At the time, the police argued that 'the suspect was heavily intoxicated, so no intent to murder could be found.'" (“보완수사는 정말 많은 사건의 암장을 막는다. 2018년 거제에서 20대 남성이 폐지를 줍던 노인을 무차별 폭행한 뒤 살해한 뒤 상해치사 혐의로 송치된 사건이 있다. 상해치사는 피해자 측과 합의하면 집행유예 판결을 받는 경우가 있다. 그런데 검사가 이 사건을 확인하면서 범인이 휴대폰에서 ‘사람이 죽었는지 안 죽었는지 확인하는 법’을 검색해 보고, 사람에게 가장 약한 부위인 머리를 집중해서 폭행한 점을 잡아내서 살인죄로 기소했다. 결국 징역 35년이 나왔다. 만약 이 사건에 대해 그냥 경찰에 보완수사 요구를 했으면 어떻게 됐겠나. 당시 경찰은 ‘범인이 만취 상태였기 때문에 살인의 고의를 찾아볼 수 없었다’고 주장했었다.”)

-What direction should the revision of the Criminal Procedure Act take? (-형사소송법 개정 방향이 어떻게 돼야 한다고 보나.)

"Our country's judicial system is already too broken, and at the scene, victims of crime are unable to resolve their grievances. The supplementary investigation right is just a temporary fix at this point; we need to completely redraw the framework from scratch." (“우리나라 사법 제도는 이미 너무 망가졌고, 현장에선 범죄 피해를 입은 사람들이 억울함을 해소하지 못하는 상황이 됐다. 보완수사권도 현재로선 임시방편에 불과할 뿐, 처음부터 새로 판을 짜야 한다.”)

item.title: PARK Soo-young of the People Power Party Calls on "Lee Jae-myung Administration to Reveal Reckless Background" Behind 'Samsung and SK Hynix ETF Plunge' (野박수영, ‘삼전닉스 ETF 폭락’에 “李정권 무리한 출시 배경 밝혀야”)
item.description:
PARK Soo-young of the People Power Party Calls on "Lee Jae-myung Administration to Reveal Reckless Background" Behind 'Samsung and SK Hynix ETF Plunge' (野박수영, ‘삼전닉스 ETF 폭락’에 “李정권 무리한 출시 배경 밝혀야”)

Rep. Park Soo-young of the People Power Party on the 9th held President Lee Jae-myung and Presidential Chief of Staff for Policy Kim Yong-beom accountable, pointing out the volatility in the KOSPI market and harm to individual investors caused by the introduction of single-stock leveraged ETF products for Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix. (국민의힘 박수영 의원은 9일 삼성전자와 SK하이닉스 단일 종목 레버리지 ETF 상품 도입으로 인한 코스피 시장의 변동성과 개인 투자자 피해를 지적하면서 이재명 대통령과 김용범 청와대 정책실장의 책임을 물었다.)

Rep. Park said on Facebook the same day, "The stock market is fluctuating like a scene from a casino movie, causing massive losses for retail investors," and "The masterminds behind this tragedy are the lead actor, Presidential Chief of Staff for Policy Kim Yong-beom, and the director, President Lee Jae-myung." According to Rep. Park, these products have plummeted by about 40% over the past week, falling below their listing prices. (박 의원은 이날 페이스북에서 “주식시장이 카지노 영화의 한 장면처럼 출렁이며 개미들의 피해가 속출하고 있다”며 “이 비극을 만든 장본인은 주연 김용범 청와대 정책실장, 감독 이재명 대통령”이라고 했다. 박 의원에 따르면, 해당 상품들은 최근 일주일 새 낙폭이 40% 수준에 달하며 상장가 아래로 폭락했다.)

Rep. Park criticized the process of launching these products just four months after Chief Kim's private meeting with securities firm CEOs in January as "runaway recklessness." He claimed that the government, which had previously blamed 'retail investors trading US stocks' for the rapid rise in exchange rates, pushed through the Financial Services Commission's legislative notice and enforcement decree amendments at breakneck speed. Rep. Park said, "Suggestions to launch multi-stock ETFs to prevent market concentration were ignored," and "Rather than concerns over investment losses, the Lee Jae-myung administration's sole goal was to launch the products ahead of local elections and boost stock prices." (박 의원은 지난 1월 김 실장과 증권사 CEO들의 비공개 간담회 이후 불과 넉 달 만에 상품이 출시된 과정을 “폭주 수준”이라고 비판했다. 당시 환율 급등 책임을 ‘서학 개미’ 탓으로 돌리던 정부가 금융위 입법 예고와 시행령 개정을 속전속결로 밀어붙였다는 것이다. 박 의원은 “시장 쏠림을 막기 위한 여러 종목 ETF 출시 건의는 묵살됐다”며 “투자 피해 우려보다 지방선거 전 상품 출시와 주가 부양이 이재명 정권의 유일한 목표였던 것”이라고 했다.)

He further said to President Lee, "You must have been the director overseeing and approving the entire process," and "We must hold you accountable for staking the investments and future of the Republic of Korea to turn the stock market into a gambling den." Rep. Park added that if the Lee Jae-myung administration does not voluntarily disclose its decision-making process, he will push for a parliamentary audit. (또한 이 대통령을 향해 “모든 과정을 보고받고 진행시킨 감독 역할이었을 것”이라며 “대한민국 투자자와 미래를 판돈 삼아 주식시장을 도박판으로 만든 책임을 반드시 물어야 한다”고 했다. 그러면서 이재명 정권이 결정 과정을 스스로 밝히지 않는다면 국회 국정조사를 추진하겠다고 했다.)

item.title: "Korea-Style Military AI That Integrates Reconnaissance Information Must Be Developed" (“정찰 정보 통합하는 한국형 군 AI 개발해야”)
item.description:
"Korea-Style Military AI That Integrates Reconnaissance Information Must Be Developed" (“정찰 정보 통합하는 한국형 군 AI 개발해야”)

On the 9th, the Republic of Korea Army held the 12th Army Force Forum at the Defense Convention in Yongsan-gu, Seoul, discussing plans for the Army's transformation into a future advanced science and technology force tailored to battlefield environments such as artificial intelligence (AI) and drones. (육군이 9일 서울 용산구 국방컨벤션에서 제12회 육군력 포럼을 열고 인공지능(AI), 드론 등 전장 환경에 맞춰 미래 첨단 과학기술군으로서의 육군의 변화 방안을 논의했다.)

The Army Force Forum is an annual event held since 2015, where civilian and military experts in security and defense fields discuss the Army's role and future development direction to build social consensus. Approximately 300 people attended the forum, including Army Chief of Staff General Kim Gyu-ha, Ewha Womans University President Lee Hyang-sook, People Power Party lawmaker Yoo Yong-won, Jo Kuk Innovation Party lawmaker Baek Seon-hee, and military officials. (육군력 포럼은 민간과 군의 안보·군사 분야 전문가들이 육군의 역할과 미래 발전 방향을 논의하고 사회적 공감대를 형성하기 위해 2015년부터 매년 열리는 행사다. 이날 포럼엔 김규하 육군참모총장을 비롯해 이향숙 이화여자대학교 총장, 국민의힘 유용원 의원, 조국혁신당 백선희 의원과 군 관계자 등 총 300여 명이 참석했다.)

This year's forum, held under the theme 'Future Warfare and Army Capabilities,' assessed future security environments and changes in warfare patterns, discussing future battlefield tactics and the 'Next Army TIGER+' concept beyond the Army TIGER+ initiative, which aims for 2040. (‘미래 전쟁과 육군의 능력’을 주제로 열린 올해 포럼은 미래 안보 환경과 전쟁 양상 변화를 진단하고 미래 전장 전투법과 2040년을 목표로 추진하는 아미타이거 플러스(Army TIGER+)를 넘어 ‘넥스트(Next) 아미타이거 플러스’ 구상을 논의했다.)

Army TIGER+ is an initiative to make AI, drones and counter-drones, robots, and cyber-electromagnetic capabilities core strengths of the entire Army. (아미타이거 플러스는 AI, 드론 및 대드론, 로봇, 사이버·전자기 능력을 육군 전체의 핵심 전력으로 만드는 구상이다.)

Chief of Staff General Kim Gyu-ha stated, "Army power is divided into internal and external forces, and it can be exerted powerfully only when these two forces harmoniously interlock and converge. It is completed when the sense of mission and responsibility to protect the precious daily lives of the people, the pride in having fulfilled that, and the tangible combat power centered on Army TIGER+ are strengthened." (김규하 참모총장은 “육군력은 내적인 힘과 외적인 힘으로 나뉘며 두 힘이 조화롭게 맞물려 융합될 때 비로소 강력하게 발휘될 수 있다”며 “국민의 소중한 일상을 지킨다는 사명감과 책임감, 그것을 실천해 왔다는 자부심, 아미타이거 플러스 중심의 유형 전투력이 강화될 때 완성된다”고 했다.)

In Session 1, held under the theme 'The Unchanging Values of the Army in Terms of Role Change and Continuity,' participants shared the values and military spirit the Army must uphold in a changing security environment, as well as the roles and identity demanded by recent warfare patterns. (‘육군 역할 변화와 연속성 측면에서 본 육군의 불변 가치’를 주제로 진행한 1세션에서는 변화하는 안보 환경에서 육군이 지켜야 할 가치와 군인정신, 최근 전쟁 양상에서 요구하는 육군의 역할과 정체성 등을 공유했다.)

Lee Jang-wook, Director of the Korea Institute for Defense Analyses (KIDA), who presented in Session 1, said, "Despite rapidly changing warfare patterns, victory or defeat in war depends on territorial control," adding, "Territorial control and domination are irreplaceable capabilities and roles of ground forces." (1세션에서 발표한 이장욱 한국국방연구원(KIDA) 연구실장은 “급변하는 전쟁 양상에도 전쟁의 승패는 영토의 장악에 달려있다”며 “영토의 장악과 통제는 지상군의 대체 불가한 역량과 역할”이라고 했다.)

In Session 2, held under the theme 'How Will We Fight? Advanced Science and Technology and the Future Army,' the role of the Army in future AI battlefields was examined, along with foundational capabilities the Army needs to develop, such as leveraging human-centered combat technology, crafting new strategies based on advanced technology, and strengthening intangible combat power. (이어 ‘어떻게 싸울 것인가? 첨단 과학기술과 미래 육군’을 주제로 진행한 2세션에서는 AI 미래 전장에서 육군의 역할을 살피고 사람·전투 중심 기술 활용, 첨단 기술 기반 신전략 구상, 무형 전력 강화 등 육군이 앞으로 갖춰나가야 할 기본 역량들을 살폈다.)

Professor Kim Yang-gyu of Korea National Defense University, who presented in Session 2, noted, "In a multi-domain battlefield combining drone, cyber, space, electromagnetic, and robotic systems, processing vast amounts of information with human staff alone, without AI, is becoming increasingly difficult," and emphasized, "It is urgent to develop a unique Korean military AI model that can establish a multi-layered surveillance and reconnaissance system and rapidly integrate collected information." (2세션 발제자로 나선 김양규 국방대 교수는 “드론·사이버·우주·전자기·로봇 체계가 결합되는 다영역 전장에서 AI 없이 인간 참모만으로 엄청난 양의 정보를 처리하는 것은 점점 더 어려워지고 있다”며 “다층 감시 정찰 체계를 구축하고 수집된 정보를 빠르게 통합할 수 있는 한국군의 독자적인 군 AI 모델 개발이 시급하다”고 했다.)

The final Session 3, under the theme 'The Next Army TIGER+ Concept at the Core of the Future Army,' shared opinions on the role and development direction of the Army in the multi-domain, unmanned era beyond 2040. (마지막 3세션은 ‘미래 육군의 중심 넥스트 아미타이거 플러스 구상’을 주제로 2040년 이후 다영역·무인화 시대 육군의 역할과 발전 방향에 대한 의견을 나눴다.)

Professor Lee Yong-bok of Korea National Defense University, who presented in Session 3, said, "Implementing future Army combat systems is a practical solution to the structural problem of declining military service resources," and argued, "Building sovereign AI, along with structuring requirements and establishing capability evaluation infrastructure, will allow defense capabilities to be maintained with a standing force of 270,000 troops by 2040." (3세션 발표를 맡은 이용복 국방대 교수는 “미래 육군 전투 체계 구현이 병역 자원 감소라는 구조적 문제에 대한 실질적 해법”이라며 “소버린 AI(주권 AI)를 비롯해 요구 사항 구조화, 능력 평가 인프라 등을 구축해야 2040년 27만명의 상비 병력으로도 방위 능력을 갖출 수 있다”고 했다.)

Army Policy Director (Major General) Lee Kyung-jin commented, "It was a time for experts from industry, academia, and research institutes, along with future leaders from spearhead units, to come together and examine the Army's unchanging values and role in protecting the daily lives of the people," adding, "We will carefully consider the discussed opinions and actively reflect them in strategies and policies for Army development." (이경진 육군 정책실장(소장)은 “산학연 전문가와 창끝 부대 미래 주역들이 모여 국민의 일상을 수호하는 육군의 불변의 가치와 역할을 조망하는 시간이었다”면서 “논의된 의견을 숙고해 육군 발전을 위한 전략과 정책에 적극 반영하겠다”라고 했다.)

item.title: "Even for South Korean Films, We Must Unify"... North Korean Residents React to Hallyu (“남조선 영화때문이라도 통일해야”... 한류접한 北 주민들 반응)
item.description:
"Even for South Korean Films, We Must Unify"... North Korean Residents React to Hallyu (“남조선 영화때문이라도 통일해야”... 한류접한 北 주민들 반응 )

#1. "I feel like I've finally watched a real film. Our country (North Korea) must achieve national unification, if only for South Korean movies. My comrades and I sighed seeing a submarine the size of a building while people aren't even being fed. If I had been born as General Kim Jong-il's son, I could do that too." (A man in his 30s from Pyongyang, after watching the drama 'Police Station Next to Fire Station and the National Forensic Service') (#1.“이제야 진짜 영화다운 영화를 본 것 같다. 우리나라(북한)는 남조선 영화때문이라도 조국통일해야 한다. 힘든 사람들에게 먹이지도 않으면서 집체만한 잠수함 만든 것 보고 동무들이랑 한숨을 쉬었다. 나도 김정일 장군님 아들로 태어났으면 저런 것 할 수 있다.” (드라마 ‘소방서 옆 경찰서 그리고 국과수’를 본 평양의 30대 남성))

#2. "I saw how people dress in capitalist countries, and I don't think I could walk on the street like that. Our country has suppressed the spring sunshine-like hearts of our girls since childhood. My desire to follow beautiful things clashes with my thoughts that it's wrong, and I can't tell which is which. Seeing photos of people dressed like this makes me envious and want to live that way too." (A woman in her 20s from Jagang Province, after encountering the fashion magazine 'Cosmopolitan') (#.2 “자본주의 나라의 옷차림을 봤는데 난 이렇게 입고 거리 바닥에 못 다닐 것 같다. 나라가 우리 처녀들의 봄햇살 같은 마음을 어려서부터 다 짓눌러 놨다. 고운 것을 따라하고픈 내 속 생각과 그럼 안된다는 내 생각이 부딪히는데 뭐가 난지 잘 모르겠다. 이렇게 입은 사진 보면 나도 이렇게 살고 싶은 부러움이 든다.” (패션잡지 ‘코스모폴리탄’을 접한 자강도의 20대 여성))

#3. "I think this is the most entertaining film I've ever seen. I didn't do anything for three days, locked the door from the outside, and watched it from start to finish." (A woman in her 50s from North Pyongan Province, after watching the drama 'Crash Landing on You') (#.3 “이렇게 재밌는 영화는 처음 본 것 같다. 3일 동안 아무 일도 하지 않고 밖으로 문을 걸어 잠그고 처음부터 끝까지 다 보았다.” (드라마 ‘사랑의 불시착’을 본 평안북도의 50대 여성))

At a seminar held on the 9th by the 'Citizens' Alliance for North Korean Human Rights', impressions from North Korean residents who had encountered South Korean films, dramas, and music—the Hallyu wave—were shared. (9일 ‘북한인권시민연합’이 개최한 세미나에서 남한의 영화, 드라마, 음악 등 한류(寒流)를 접한 북한 주민들의 소감이 소개됐다.)

Lee Gwang-baek, a private North Korea broadcasting expert and CEO of National Unification Broadcasting and Daily NK, presented strategies for content sent to North Korean residents at the seminar, stating, "The proportion of cultural and entertainment content like dramas, films, and music should be increased." He released impressions that North Korean residents had personally conveyed years ago after encountering Hallyu content. (민간 대북방송 전문가인 이광백 국민통일방송·데일리NK 대표는 이날 세미나에서 북한 주민들에게 보내는 콘텐츠 전략과 관련해 “드라마와 영화, 음악 등 문화·오락 콘텐츠 비중을 높여야 한다”며 한류 콘텐츠를 접한 북한 주민들이 몇해 전 직접 전해온 소감을 발표했다.)

A woman in her 40s from North Pyongan Province, who watched the 2024 drama 'The Return of Superman' (likely a mistranslation; context suggests a different title), wrote in her review: "I wish there were security personnel who could take those with connections and influence—who only let ordinary people with no background die while they swagger around bullying others—and teach them a lesson where money and connections don't work." A man in his 30s from Pyongyang, who watched the 2023 drama 'Police Station Next to Fire Station and the National Forensic Service', said: "I'm not asking for rice with the money spent on submarines, so at least make impressive films so people can enjoy life and make this a proper country. I've tried to express the frustration of living in a country where I can't speak my mind even though I have a mouth." (2024년 드라마 ‘재벌형사 1’을 본 평안북도 40대 여성은 소감문에서 “빽(배경), 안면 없는 백성들만 죽고 힘있는 것들은 거들먹 거리면서 삿대질 해가면서 다니는 것을 돈도 빽도 안 통하는데로 데려다가 혼내주는 안전원들이 있으면 좋겠다”고 했다. 2023년 드라마 ‘소방서 옆 경찰서 그리고 국과수’를 본 평양의 30대 남성은 “잠수함에 들어갈 돈으로 쌀 달라는 소리 제발 안하니까 영화라도 멋있게 만들어서 사람들이 살아갈 락(낙)을 누리게 해주면 나라답겠다. 입이 있어도 내 마음 속 말을 못하는 나라에서 사는 답답함을 호소해봤다”고 했다.)

A military officer in his 30s from North Hamgyong Province, who encountered South Korean songs, said: "The sound and lyrics are truly gentle and so warm. When I listen after a hard day at the base, it feels like a cotton swab rubbing my heart." A laborer in his 40s from North Hamgyong Province commented: "The lyrics honestly capture human emotions and life as they are, and singing them brought tears to my eyes. It was a song that made me think about why we have to suppress our feelings and live this way." (남한 노래를 접한 함경북도의 30대 남성 군관은 “소리와 가사가 정말 잔잔하고 너무 포근하다”며 “부대에서 힘들어하고 퇴근해서 들으면 소독솜이 마음을 문지러주는 느낌”이라고 했다. 함경북도의 40대 남성 노동자는 “인간의 감정과 생활을 솔직하게 그대로 가사에 담아 노래를 부르니 눈물이 났다”며 “우리는 왜 우리들 감정을 억누르며 이렇게 살아야하는지에 대한 (생각이)드는 노래였다”고 했다.)

There was also a resident who only learned after seeing South Korean media reports that North Korea is the only country banning internet use. A woman in her 20s from Pyongyang, after reading a South Korean news article stating North Korea is the only one out of 230 countries with an internet usage rate of 0%, said: "Only after reading this article did I realize that worldwide, only our country bans internet use. We learn in school that our country is a political and military powerhouse and our people are the happiest, but I don't understand why, or what they fear, in banning people's internet access." <<>> These cases are impressions conveyed to the 'Unification Media' side by North Korean residents who participated in a 2024 survey on the audience of the private North Korea broadcaster 'National Unification Broadcasting', operated by the incorporated association 'Unification Media'. The survey of 100 North Korean residents at that time found high penetration rates of devices like LCD TVs, nottels (a type of portable media player), tablet PCs, and laptops. In response to the question "Have you ever seen South Korean or foreign recordings?", 95% of respondents said "Yes," and most said they viewed and listened to content stored on USB memory sticks or microSD cards. Using these digital storage devices to access external information via nottels or tablet PCs leaves no trace of usage or allows deletion, making it relatively safe. <<>> CEO Lee Gwang-baek stated: "Cultural and entertainment content is highly preferred by North Korean residents, making it advantageous for spreading external information, and news has also become one of the fastest-diffusing content types among North Korean residents in recent years." For news, it is particularly popular among North Korean officials, especially those engaged in trade with China, who show strong interest in international raw material prices, exchange rates, and economic trend information. Lee added: "Media devices within North Korea are continuously increasing, and the number of North Korean residents seeking external information is steadily growing. Until North Korean residents have access to the internet and satellite TV, the primary methods of providing them with information are distributing storage devices with digital content and sending radio waves." <<>> The North Korean authorities are intensively blocking the inflow of external information like Hallyu, and have strengthened punishments, including execution, for those who access or distribute South Korean content, depending on the severity. According to the North Korea-specialized media outlet Daily NK, in July 2024, the Pyongyang City Security Bureau punished two female shock troopers from the Ryugyong Construction Management Bureau Regiment for watching the South Korean drama 'Queen of Tears'. A personnel from the Pyongyang City State Tourism Administration was tried in a closed-door trial and executed for distributing South Korean films, dramas, and songs. <<>> As the North Korean authorities' control and punishments have intensified, delivering external information to North Korean residents has become much more difficult. Lee stated: "It takes a lot of time and cost to get storage devices containing Hallyu content into North Korea and establish a network for them to spread widely within the country. Due to the North Korean authorities' strict border controls, it's difficult to provide information frequently or regularly." Consequently, few organizations provide Hallyu content regularly, and even those that do manage it only once every few months or at most once a month. Lee explained: "Sending 10,000 microSD cards with capacities of 64GB to 128GB into North Korea costs at least 60 million to 170 million won just for the cards. To operate the network stably and expand the subscriber base for Hallyu content, it's best to provide information regularly and shorten the intervals." <<>> At the seminar, Lee Yang-hee, former chair of the UN Committee on the Rights of the Child, also testified about the North Korean authorities' deceptive behavior he personally witnessed at UN human rights review sessions. Lee presided over the review of North Korea's 3rd and 4th periodic reports on the Convention on the Rights of the Child (CRC) in 2009 while serving as CRC chair. He said: "What I witnessed was that North Korea sent a highly trained delegation to portray themselves as a 'normal country.' I directly saw the calculated hypocrisy orchestrated by the Pyongyang authorities." <<>> The North Korean delegation arrived in Geneva with a well-prepared team including two female simultaneous interpreters, and unlike the usual aggressive rhetoric of North Korean representatives at UN venues, they displayed very polite and professional behavior. Lee added: "During the review of the North Korean authorities' labor exploitation of students, I pressured them by presenting evidence of entire schools closing to mobilize children for harvesting crops and construction sites. The delegation strongly objected, calling it part of a 'holistic educational approach.'" He continued: "When I pointed out that mobilizing children for the large-scale mass gymnastics 'Arirang' was a form of exploitation depriving them of education, the delegation was greatly flustered. They had only prepared to argue that the children were doing this voluntarily." <<>> Mr. Kang, a former teacher in North Korea who defected in 2019 and entered South Korea in 2020, shared his experiences at the seminar: "North Korea also fears international scrutiny, paying attention to visits by international organizations, foreign media reports, and UN criticism. Even officials who normally treat residents badly change their attitude the moment they feel external eyes are on them." <<>> Mr. Kang said he was arrested by the State Security Department in May 2017 for attempting a phone call with his son in China using a Chinese cellphone. He was detained in a security department lockup for about 20 days before being released after paying money. Kang recalled: "On the third day of detention, normally I would have to bow my head when called by the investigator, but that day was different. At the time, I thought it was special treatment because I was a school teacher, but later I learned that a UN delegation was visiting North Korea." <<>> He added: "When my daughter was arrested and detained in 2014, she suffered severe beatings and had nightmares. She couldn't raise her head and had to move with her back bent almost at a right angle. But my case was different. It seems that during the UN official's visit to North Korea, such harsh treatment was temporarily suspended." On the eighth day of his detention, the investigator even offered him snacks. He said: "That would have been unthinkable under normal circumstances. The mere fact that someone at the UN was discussing North Korea's human rights issues changed the attitude of the security department." He concluded: "International attention is by no means meaningless for North Korean residents." (남한 언론 보도를 접하고서야 다른 나라들과 달리 북한만 인터넷 사용을 금지한다는 것을 알았다는 주민도 있었다. 평양의 20대 여성은 북한이 230국 중 유일하게 인터넷 사용 비율이 0이라는 남한 언론 기사를 접한 뒤 “이 기사를 보고서야 세계적으로 우리나라만 인터넷 사용을 금지한다는 것을 알았다”며 “우리가 학교에서 배우는 우리나라는 정치군사 강국이며 우리 인민은 가장 행복한 인민이라 하는데, 무엇 때문에, 무엇이 두려워 인민들의 인터넷 사용을 금지하는지 모르겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk’s Meeting with Gwangju Police Chief Over ‘Jang Yoon-gi Incident’ Falls Through... “This Is the Bare Face of How Police Treat the Public” (장동혁, ‘장윤기 사건’ 광주청장 면담 불발...“이게 국민 대하는 경찰 민낯”)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk’s Meeting with Gwangju Police Chief Over ‘Jang Yoon-gi Incident’ Falls Through... “This Is the Bare Face of How Police Treat the Public” (장동혁, ‘장윤기 사건’ 광주청장 면담 불발...“이게 국민 대하는 경찰 민낯”)

People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk and his leadership visited the Gwangju Metropolitan Police Agency on the 9th in connection with the so-called Jang Yoon-gi incident, where a female high school student was killed in Gwangju, but after about 35 minutes of wrangling, the meeting with the police chief fell through. Leader Jang said, “This is how the South Korean police treat the public,” adding, “The damage from the abolition of supplementary investigation rights will fall entirely on the people.” <<> Leader Jang made a protest visit to the Gwangju Police Agency that afternoon, but was blocked by police in the lobby and unable to enter the office space where the chief’s office is located. Initially, Leader Jang had planned to meet with new Prime Minister Han Sung-sook around the same time, but considering the urgency of the matter, he postponed the meeting and changed his schedule to visit the Gwangju Agency. Joining him on this protest visit were Supreme Council member Shin Dong-wook, Chief of Staff Park Jun-tae, Deputy Director for Strategic Planning Seo Cheon-ho, and Director of the Party Leader’s Political Affairs Office Kim Jang-kyum. <<> The Gwangju Police Agency cited reasons such as “the chief is absent due to external schedule” and “security reasons” to block their entry. Leader Jang and the accompanying lawmakers strongly protested, saying, “A case involving the violation of people’s human rights has occurred, yet it makes no sense that we can’t enter just because the chief is not here,” “This is why people point out that the police are siding with murderers in investigations,” and “Is this an attempt to further cover up the case?” It was reported that Commissioner Kim had left the office starting at 11:30 a.m. that day for a pre-scheduled field inspection of summer heavy rain preparedness. <<> They confronted the police in the lobby for about 35 minutes, but the meeting with the police chief ultimately did not happen. Speaking to reporters, Leader Jang said, “This is a clear display of the bare face of the South Korean police.” He added, “This lack of will or heart to protect the lives and safety of the people, and treating the public this way, is what led to such a crime,” and “It manifested as an attempt to destroy evidence, downplay the investigation, and cover up the case for their own kind.” <<> He then addressed the government and ruling party’s push to abolish the prosecution’s supplementary investigation rights, saying, “When the police hold all investigation authority, the damage will fall entirely on the people, and more such absurd incidents will occur,” and “Ultimately, the lives and safety of the South Korean people will be left unprotected.” <<> Shin Dong-wook, the Supreme Council member who accompanied Leader Jang to the scene, said, “The Gwangju police chief has fled somewhere for unknown reasons, and the police at the scene refuse to give any explanation and are trying to turn us away from this lobby.” He added, “Fellow citizens, I believe this is exactly what you will experience two months from now when the prosecution’s supplementary investigation rights completely disappear.” <<> Lawmaker Seo Cheon-ho, a former police officer, also stated, “Regarding this murder of a female high school student, the alleged destruction of evidence, cover-ups, and leaks of investigation secrets in the process are not a simple case of individual misconduct,” adding, “It’s an instance where active police officers, as an organization, sided with crime, sided with a murderer, and wielded state power.” <<> He further said, “This is a case where the public safety system operated maliciously in favor of crime,” and “The police still fail to recognize what they did wrong, why constitutional lawmakers came to raise the issue, and why so many media and citizens view this seriously.” <<> Lawmaker Kim Jang-kyum expressed, “I cannot hide my concern that the attitude shown by the Gwangju Police Agency today is a preview of the biased and manipulated investigations to come,” adding, “It is utterly arrogant. I am deeply disappointed.” (국민의힘 장동혁 대표와 지도부가 광주에서 여고생이 피살된 이른바 장윤기 사건과 관련해 9일 광주경찰청을 찾았지만 약 35분간 실랑이 끝에 청장 면담은 불발됐다. 장 대표는 “이게 대한민국 경찰이 국민을 대하는 태도”라며 “보완 수사권 폐지의 피해는 오롯이 국민에게 돌아갈 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: President Lee: "Expecting Mongolia's Cooperation for Peace on the Korean Peninsula" (李대통령 “몽골의 한반도평화 협력 기대”)
item.description:
President Lee: "Expecting Mongolia's Cooperation for Peace on the Korean Peninsula" (李대통령 “몽골의 한반도평화 협력 기대”)

President Lee Jae-myung, currently on a state visit to Mongolia, held a summit meeting with Mongolian President Ukhnaagiin Khürelsükh on the 9th (local time) and stated, "Based on the friendship between our two countries, we will solidify political trust between South Korea and Mongolia and deepen our strategic partnership." In his remarks at the start of the meeting held at the government building in Ulaanbaatar, President Lee said, "I hope today's meeting serves as a starting point for a new leap in bilateral relations and a historic opportunity to open a golden age in South Korea-Mongolia relations." <<> First, President Lee stated, "Based on the Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA), which reached a principled agreement yesterday, we will further expand win-win cooperation in various fields including economy, development cooperation, and health and medical care." <<> Regarding diplomatic and security issues, he said, "In a situation where uncertainty in international affairs is intensifying, we must cooperate closely for regional and global peace and development," and added, "I believe maintaining peace and stability on the Korean Peninsula and in Northeast Asia will serve the common interests of both our countries." (몽골을 국빈 방문 중인 이재명 대통령은 9일(현지 시각) 오흐나 후렐수흐 몽골 대통령과 정상회담을 갖고 “양국의 우정을 바탕으로 한국과 몽골의 정치적 신뢰를 공고히 하고 전략적 동반자 관계를 심화시켜 나갈 것”이라고 밝혔다. 이 대통령은 이날 울란바타르 시내 정부 청사에서 열린 회담 모두 발언에서 “오늘 회담이 양국 관계의 새로운 도약을 알리는 출발점이자 한·몽 관계의 황금시대를 열어가는 역사적 계기가 되기를 바란다”며 이같이 말했다.)
